label: About
title: About Corner Strap Archive
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 67 recent saved-signal files and 72 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around Anchor image material 5 and Royale Studio Archive at mitchmen, plus 5 more. A source image from blogger.googleusercontent.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Corner Strap Archive: A source-led balanced vintage archive room slab, scanned archive object with side-lit object-slab grammar. Build a monochrome staged-room plate: open plaster wall, baseboard, right corner seam, shag floor, left cropped dark vertical mass countering a centered-right body-scale silhouette. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 7 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central-right kneeling silhouette slab, lower dark floor-and-prone bar, and left black vertical wall mass.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
